name: Help Scout
description: Help Scout lets agents search support conversations, pull reports, and search Docs articles in the signed-in Help Scout account. Access is read-only, and each user signs in through the browser.

prompts.text: What were the most common customer issues this week?
Pull the response time report for last month.
Find the conversations where customers asked about refunds for annual plans.

apps.name: Help Scout
apps.description: Conversation search, reports, and Docs search, over Help Scout's MCP server with browser sign-in.
